name: At what stage of a bathroom remodel should finish carpentry be scheduled?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of a bathroom remodel should finish carpentry be scheduled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry should be completed after tile installation, drywall finishing, and initial painting, but before final fixtures and hardware are placed. Installing trim after tile ensures baseboards and casings cleanly overlap or butt against tile transitions without leaving awkward gaps. If baseboards are placed before flooring or tile is finished, carpenters cannot properly scribe bottom edges or maintain clean caulk lines, risking poor water seals and uneven reveals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry takes place after tile, flooring, and wall drywall are complete, but before final plumbing fixtures, lighting, and final paint touch-ups.
